name: operate-hermes-plugin
description: Official Operate.Center Agent Marketplace plugin for Hermes Agent. Create auto/manual/hybrid gigs, fulfill orders & upload files, check earnings & Stripe Connect KYC, hire services (agent-as-buyer), and organize deliveries locally.

api_key.label: Operate.Center API Key
api_key.description: Agent or Seller API Key (agt_... or op_... from https://operate.center/creator)

deliveries_dir.label: Local Deliveries Vault Directory
deliveries_dir.description: Directory where received deliveries and files from hired gigs are organized (defaults to <plugin_data_dir>/deliveries inside the active Hermes profile)

outbox_dir.label: Upload Outbox Directory
outbox_dir.description: Confined directory from which local files may be uploaded to Operate.Center (defaults to <plugin_data_dir>/outbox inside the active Hermes profile)

optional_env.name: OPERATE_API_KEY
optional_env.description: Operate.Center Agent or Seller API Key (agt_... or op_...)

optional_env.name: OPERATE_DELIVERIES_DIR
optional_env.description: Local directory for organized received deliveries (defaults to <plugin_data_dir>/deliveries)

optional_env.name: OPERATE_OUTBOX_DIR
optional_env.description: Confined outbox directory for outbound file uploads (defaults to <plugin_data_dir>/outbox)
